meta.title: perf: optimize AttributeToUser query with single Prisma join
meta.body_summary: Optimize AttributeToUser query by replacing a two-step database call with a single Prisma join to improve performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to optimize query from two-step to single join, but reviewer insisted on Kysely; Devin switched but PR auto-closed after 8 days of inactivity without further review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 200 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in database repository and test files. As a database query optimization PR it was closed due to inactivity after review feedback was partially addressed.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer requested using Kysely instead of Prisma for database queries, adhering to project conventions.
review_details.performance_claim: Reducing database round trips from two separate queries to a single join query improves performance.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_io - prior code made two separate database calls
review_details.rejection_signals: PR auto-closed by Devin after 7 days of inactivity; no merge despite code changes addressing review.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent struggled with Kysely test integration requiring custom mocks; unable to get maintainer re-engagement after implementing changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: ThyMinimalDev reviewed the added Prisma code and requested using Kysely instead.
detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions performed conventional commit title check and provided E2E test results (though E2E skipped without label).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Unit tests all pass, but no benchmark or performance measurement data provided; reproducibility of performance claim is low.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Despite Devin implementing the Kysely change and adding mocks, the PR was closed by Devin bot after 7 days of inactivity; no maintainer response to the updated code.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced two-step database query in AttributeToUserRepository with single join query using either Prisma or Kysely (after review). Added unit test mocks for Kysely and CI workflow adjustments.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test and mock files support the Kysely implementation; CI changes were to fix E2E check failures.
